name: CESC Ltd.
about: CESC Limited, an integrated electrical utility company, engages in the generation and distribution of electricity in India. It owns and operates two thermal power plants, including Budge Budge generating station with a generating capacity of 750 megawatts and Southern generating stations with a generating capacity of 135 megawatts; a 40-megawatt atmospheric fluidized bed combustion power plant in Asansol, West Bengal; a 300-megawatt solar project in Bhadla, Rajasthan; and a 450-megawatt hybrid project that consists of a 150-megawatt solar unit in Bikaner, Rajasthan and a 300-megawatt wind unit in Ananthapuram, Andhra Pradesh. The company serves domestic, industrial, commercial, government agencies, pumping stations, local bodies, schools etc. CESC Limited was founded in 1899 and is headquartered in Kolkata, India.

verdict.label: Looks cheap
reasons: Price implies only ~6% a year growth, below the ~9% that history and analysts support, so expectations look modest.
PE of 11 is near the bottom of its range over the last 3 years (median 15), though that is a short history to judge by.
Trades at PE 11 vs a quality-and-growth-justified 22 for this sector; cheaper than peers of similar quality.
High leverage (D/E 1.7x) raises risk; equity value is sensitive to interest costs.
Since 2023, most of the 19% a year price gain came from re-rating (PE 7 → 11), not earnings growth (4% a year).
